generic_sampling_rules.integer_pk: Sequential integers starting at 1, unique within table; never NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_fk: Sample from the parent table's generated primary-key values; never NULL unless the column is nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_numeric: Uniform integer in the observed min..max range; include boundary values and one step beyond each boundary.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_text: Random short strings; include near-variants (case changes, one-character edits, truncations) of any literal named in per_column_exceptions.
generic_sampling_rules.char_code: Pick from the enum pool; include case variants and near-variants of listed literals.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: For nullable columns, ~10% NULL rows per instance, at least one NULL row.
generic_sampling_rules.fresh_values_share: At least 30% of text values are fresh (not copied from observed rows).

issues.evidence: specgen.py implements the specified value domains: SOURCE_SYSTEM_ENUM matches the six observed values; _source_system_values mixes enum, boundary literals ('Electoral','Tax','electoral','tax') and case variants; _cmi_details_values uses CMI_DETAILS_BOUNDARY plus case variants and fresh strings; PKs are sequential fresh integers starting above the compact max (POSITIVE_PK_TABLES ensures >=1). Dependencies are honored: FK columns draw from parent_rows (compact + generated), and the writer appends rows in FK order. Group-size plans (_group_size_plan) cover sizes 1, 2, >=3 for the five listed columns; duplicates_for_distinct applies a 20-50% duplicate share on CMI_Cross_References.cmi_cross_ref_id; _ensure_unmatched guarantees at least one CMI_Cross_References parent without a Parking_Fines child.
issues.requested_revision: None blocking. Minor observation: the aggregate_boundary target 'COUNT(*) values 0,1,2' is only partially constructed — 0 is guaranteed via _ensure_unmatched, but 1 and 2 are not explicitly forced (they arise only probabilistically from random FK sampling). Since the spec itself labels these as 'sampling hints, not constraints', this is acceptable, but the engineer could add explicit construction if stronger coverage is desired.

unresolved_checks: Aggregate-boundary COUNT(*) values 1 and 2 are not deterministically constructed; only 0 is guaranteed. This is consistent with the spec's 'sampling hints' framing but means the target is only probabilistically met.

The 'fresh_values_share >= 30%' generic rule is applied only to generic-sampled columns; the special-cased source_system_code and cmi_details columns use their own mix (which does include fresh strings for cmi_details but not for source_system_code, where all values come from the enum/boundary pool). This is arguably intended given the enum domain, but is not explicitly reconciled in the spec.
